monday.label: Monday
monday.focus: Core + Turkish get-up + posture + active mobility (gym legs later)
monday.later: Evening gym: quads + pull + Zone 2 (50 min)

steps.title: 360° breathing + pelvic floor
steps.details: 5 slow 360° breaths, then 5 × 3-sec gentle pelvic-floor lifts, fully relaxing for 6–8 sec after each; no constant clenching.
steps.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Keep a comfortable neutral low back; do not force it flat into the floor.
steps.feel: Lower ribs, belly and back expand on the inhale. Pelvic floor fully relaxes between contractions.
steps.avoid: No breath holding, hard bracing or continuous pelvic-floor clenching.
steps.minuteCue: Keep the breathing calm and make the relaxation phase as deliberate as the lift.

steps.title: Kneeling Ab Wheel
steps.details: 2 × 5–8 controlled rollouts; ~45–60 sec between sets. Keep abdomen/pelvis controlled; progress range before reps.
steps.setup: Kneel on the mat with the wheel under the shoulders. Lightly brace, keep breathing and move from the shoulders/hips as one controlled unit.
steps.feel: Strong front-abdominal-wall and deep-core tension while the spine stays controlled.
steps.avoid: Stop or shorten range if the abdomen domes/cones, the low back pinches, pelvic/perineal symptoms increase, or you need a hard prolonged breath-hold.
steps.minuteCue: Reset the breath between reps; range quality matters more than distance.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Turkish Get-Up
steps.details: 1–2 slow singles per side, alternating. Unloaded or light DB. Technique quality and shoulder comfort first; roughly RPE 6.
steps.setup: Keep the working arm stacked and stable as you roll, post, bridge/sweep, kneel and stand. Reverse the same sequence under control.
steps.feel: Whole-body coordination: shoulder/scapular stability, trunk control, hips and legs working together.
steps.avoid: No rushing, grinding or breath holding. Do not force through right-shoulder pinching, instability or painful overhead range; reduce load/range if needed.
steps.minuteCue: Switch sides regularly and keep every position deliberate.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Chin tucks
steps.details: 2 × 8 controlled, keep neck long.
steps.feel: Gentle work deep in the front of the neck; back of the neck stays long.
steps.avoid: Do not jam the chin down toward the chest.
steps.minuteCue: Start the second controlled set.

steps.title: Wall slides
steps.details: 2 × 8 smooth pain-free overhead movement; no shoulder pinching.
steps.avoid: Do not compensate by strongly arching the low back or flaring the ribs.
steps.minuteCue: Start the second set.

steps.title: Prone Y–T–W
steps.details: 1–2 controlled rounds × 6 per shape; move through shoulder blades, not lumbar arch.
steps.minuteCue: Continue the sequence; move into the next letter or second round.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Seated Bent-Knee Hip Lifts
steps.details: 1 × 6–8 each side; easy activation before evening leg gym, RPE 5–6.
steps.setup: Sit tall on a stable seat; raise one bent knee from the hip without leaning back.
steps.feel: Controlled work high in the front of the hip, not a cramp.
steps.avoid: Do not lean back, force range, or reproduce tingling or numbness.
steps.minuteCue: Switch legs and preserve a quiet pelvis.

steps.title: Yoga Flow A — front/back chain
steps.details: Active positions only; avoid prolonged passive hamstring holds; controlled breathing.
steps.setup: Use the whole mat. In Low Lunge the rear knee can stay down; lift both arms overhead and grow tall through the torso.
steps.feel: Shoulders, spine, front of hips, calves and posterior chain working together.
steps.avoid: Do not force Upward Dog if Cobra feels better. Avoid painful end ranges or breath holding.
steps.minuteCue: Keep moving smoothly and give both lead legs equal time.

steps.title: Yoga Flow B — spine + side body
steps.details: Short active spinal and side-body transitions, no forced end range.
steps.setup: Move slowly between positions. In Thread the Needle rotate through the upper back rather than forcing the shoulder. In Puppy Pose keep hips roughly over knees and reach the chest forward/down only as comfortable.
steps.feel: Thoracic rotation, lats, side body, shoulders and spinal movement without loading the legs heavily.
steps.avoid: Do not force the shoulder into the floor or collapse into the low back.
steps.minuteCue: Move smoothly; prioritize thoracic rotation and shoulder comfort rather than forcing range.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Deep Squat + Overhead Reach
steps.details: Comfortable controlled squat and reach for ~1 min; no forced shoulder range.
steps.setup: Use a stance that lets you sit deep without pain. Let the knees track naturally over the toes and keep the whole foot connected to the floor.
steps.feel: Ankles, hips, adductors, upper back and shoulders opening together.
steps.avoid: Do not force squat depth or overhead range. Keep the movement pain-free and avoid collapsing the chest.
steps.minuteCue: Keep the reps slow and use each reach to grow taller through the upper back.

tuesday.focus: Active hip flexion + handstand + shoulders + arms

steps.title: Band-Resisted Standing March
steps.details: 2 × 8–10 reps/side, hold top 2 sec and lower slowly; 30–45 sec rest; ~RPE 6–7.
steps.setup: Anchor a light band securely around the lifting foot/ankle with appropriate resistance. Stand tall near a support.
steps.feel: Active hip flexion with level pelvis.
steps.avoid: No trunk lean, painful anterior hip pinch, nerve symptoms, or cramp-like grinding.
steps.minuteCue: Pause 2 sec at the top and lower each rep slowly.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Handstand practice
steps.details: 3 min of easy wall-assisted attempts or wall lean; stop with right-shoulder pinching, abnormal head pressure or abdominal doming.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Pike push-ups
steps.details: 3 × 8–12 with ~45–60 sec rest; controlled pain-free range, 2–3 RIR; use incline push-ups if the shoulder pinches.

steps.title: DB lateral raise
steps.details: 2 × 12–20; controlled 2–3-sec lowering, 1–2 RIR.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: DB overhead triceps extension
steps.details: 3 × 10–15; ~45–60-sec rest, 1–2 RIR. If shoulder hurts, use pain-free DB floor press.

steps.title: Alternating / supinating DB curl
steps.details: 3 × 8–12; steady elbows, no swinging, 1–2 RIR.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Band External Rotation
steps.details: 1 × 12–15/side at light resistance, elbow comfortably by ribs; no painful range.

steps.title: 360° breathing + pelvic floor
steps.details: 5 slow 360° breaths, then 5 × 3-sec gentle pelvic-floor lifts, fully relaxing for 6–8 sec after each; no constant clenching.
steps.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Keep a comfortable neutral low back; do not force it flat into the floor.

steps.title: Knee-supported side plank leg raise
steps.details: 2 × 4–6 slow top-leg lifts/side; ~45–60 sec rest. Start bottom-knee supported; aim for pelvis control before increasing lever.
steps.setup: Forearm under shoulder, bottom knee supported. Lift the pelvis, then slowly raise the top leg.
steps.feel: Bottom-side trunk/hip supporting, top hip abducting.
steps.avoid: Do not let pelvis collapse or hike the hip; regress to knee-supported holds if form fails.
steps.minuteCue: Prioritize stable pelvis and short controlled reps.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Knee-supported Copenhagen plank
steps.details: Two sets of 10–15-sec holds per side, upper knee on secure stable support; ~45–60 sec rest. If too hard, use side-lying adductor lifts.
steps.setup: Upper knee supported on a sturdy, secure surface; lower knee bent. Lift hips only as high as controlled.
steps.feel: Inner thigh and lateral trunk working; start with short holds.
steps.avoid: No maximal holds, sharp groin pain or pelvic-floor symptoms; use side-lying adduction if too hard.
steps.minuteCue: Switch sides and relax between holds.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Bear-Plank DB Drag
steps.details: 2 × 6 slow drags/side, knees hover briefly and hips stay still. Light DB, 2–3 RIR.
steps.setup: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, toes planted. Keep the pelvis square while the free hand drags the dumbbell across.
steps.feel: Deep core, obliques, shoulders and hips stabilising together.
steps.avoid: Do not let the hips twist, low back sag or abdomen dome/cone. Put the knees down if control is lost.
steps.minuteCue: Move slowly; the goal is anti-rotation, not speed.

steps.title: DB pullover dead bug
steps.details: 2 × 6/side, exhale during effort; no lumbar arch or abdominal doming.
steps.setup: Lie on your back, hips and knees around 90°. Arms start straight above the chest. Use a modest dumbbell.
steps.feel: Front abs/deep core resisting extension while the arm and opposite-leg levers lengthen.
steps.avoid: For now, do not hold the dumbbell permanently far behind the head while lowering both legs together like a weighted hollow-body leg lower. That is a later progression. Stop/regress if the abdomen domes/cones or the low back takes over.
steps.minuteCue: One leg at a time; dumbbell travels chest → controlled behind-head range → chest.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Assisted L-sit progression on yoga blocks
steps.details: Three clean 8–15-sec tuck holds. Use stable yoga blocks/supports only; regress to seated tuck/hip compression if unavailable.
steps.setup: Blocks beside the hips, shoulders pushed down away from ears, elbows straight. Lean slightly forward as needed to get the hips light.
steps.feel: Triceps, shoulders, abs and hip flexors working together. The current assisted version should already feel challenging.
steps.avoid: Do not force both feet off the floor just because the exercise is called an L-sit. Do not hold your breath or let the shoulders collapse upward.
steps.minuteCue: Quality progression: support hold → one-leg tuck → toe-assisted tuck → only later full tuck.

steps.title: 90/90 hip switches
steps.details: 1–2 × 6/side, slow active rotation with no forced stretch.
steps.minuteCue: Keep switching sides smoothly.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: DB Windmill
steps.details: One or two sets of 4–6 slow reps per side, bodyweight or very light DB. Hip hinge + trunk control; no forced overhead shoulder position.
steps.setup: Use a comfortable wider stance. Turn the feet slightly, keep the loaded arm vertical, push the hips back and slide the free hand down the inside of the leg.
steps.feel: Obliques, hips, hamstrings, upper-back rotation and shoulder/scapular stability working together.
steps.avoid: Do not chase depth or load. Stop or reduce range if the right shoulder pinches, feels unstable, or the low back takes over.
steps.minuteCue: Switch sides and keep the overhead arm stacked rather than drifting forward.

steps.title: REST / transition

steps.title: Wall slides

steps.avoid: Do not compensate by strongly arching the low back or flaring the ribs.

steps.title: Band Face Pull + External Rotation

steps.details: Active controlled squat hold with steady breathing; RPE 5–6.
steps.avoid: Reduce depth if the knee pinch appears.

steps.title: Warrior II — LEFT
steps.details: Active left-sided hold, pelvis level, front knee controlled.
steps.avoid: Do not let the front knee collapse inward.

steps.title: Extended Side Angle — LEFT
steps.details: Short active left-side hold, reach only as shoulder allows.
steps.avoid: Do not dump bodyweight into the lower arm.

steps.title: Warrior II — RIGHT
steps.details: Active right-sided hold, pelvis level.
steps.avoid: Do not let the front knee collapse inward.

steps.title: Extended Side Angle — RIGHT
steps.details: Short active right-side hold, reach only as shoulder allows.
steps.avoid: Do not dump bodyweight into the lower arm.

steps.title: Goddess Squat
steps.details: Controlled active wide squat hold, stay well below fatigue before evening gym.
steps.avoid: Stay above any depth that creates knee pinch.

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Open book
steps.details: 1 × 6 slow thoracic rotations/side, avoid forcing the lumbar spine.
steps.minuteCue: Change side.

steps.title: Suitcase March + Opposite Knee Drive
steps.details: Slow weighted march for 3 min, switch hand halfway. Stay upright, drive knee without side-bending; ~RPE 6.
steps.setup: Stand tall with ribs stacked over pelvis. Keep the dumbbell close to one thigh and lift each knee without leaning away from the weight.
steps.feel: Obliques, deep core, grip, hip flexors and pelvic stability working together.
steps.avoid: Do not side-bend, rush or hold your breath. Use a load you can control without trunk compensation.
steps.minuteCue: Switch the dumbbell to the other hand and keep the pelvis level.

steps.title: REST / transition

steps.title: DB triceps kickback

steps.title: REST / transition

steps.title: Seated Straight-Leg Lift / Compression
steps.details: 2 × 4–6 small controlled lifts/leg with 2–5-sec holds. Keep 2–3 RIR; stop before high-thigh cramp sensation.
steps.setup: Sit tall with legs forward and hands by hips; lift one nearly straight leg a little, then lower.
steps.feel: Gentle-to-moderate active front-hip/anterior thigh effort.
steps.avoid: Stop well before cramp-like fatigue; do not lean back or provoke foot numbness. Use bent knee or symptom-free supine raise to regress.
steps.minuteCue: Keep lifts only 2–5 sec, switch sides, record clean lift height.

steps.title: Supported hip airplanes

steps.title: REST / transition
steps.details: Switch equipment and breathe normally.

steps.title: Hamstring sweeps
steps.details: Gentle active sweeps, 8/side; no aggressive nerve-like stretching.

steps.title: Low Step-Ups
steps.details: 2 × 8/leg on a stable ~20–25 cm step. Use front leg to rise, lower slowly for 2–3 sec, RPE 6–7.
steps.setup: Use a stable low step; begin with the left leg. Tap back foot lightly at top.
steps.feel: Front-leg quad and glute control.
steps.avoid: No unstable chair, pushing off strongly with the trailing foot, or knee pinch.
steps.minuteCue: Match both sides and use slow lowering.

steps.title: Calm 360° breathing
steps.details: Easy relaxed breathing. Full pelvic-floor relaxation; no strenuous Kegels.
steps.setup: On your back, knees bent, feet flat. Support your head if that is more comfortable.
steps.feel: Expansion around lower ribs, belly and back; calm breathing and pelvic-floor relaxation.
steps.avoid: Do not flatten the low back, suck the belly in, brace hard or hold your breath.
steps.minuteCue: Check: ribs + belly + back are all moving, not only the upper chest.

steps.avoid: Do not lift the heel or let the knee collapse inward.
